quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson evaluates players with the most gravity in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Stephen Curry. The gold standard for off-ball perimeter gravity, constantly forcing defenders to chase him.
quotes.quote: Stephen Curry. The gold standard for off-ball perimeter gravity, constantly forcing defenders to chase him. Luka Doncic. Leads the NBA in on-ball perimeter gravity due to his elite, heliocentric scoring and playmaking. Anthony Edwards. Constantly draws early double teams and aggressive blitzes. James Harden. Wields elite on-ball gravity with his lethal step-back three and paint-drawing ability. Jalen Brunson. Uses tight handles and scoring prowess to collapse interior defenses. Jayson Tatum. His size and three-level scoring require constant multi-player defense the moment he touches the ball. Joel Embiid. Commands massive interior and on-ball gravity, drawing double teams the moment he touches the ball. Victor Wembanyama. His historically efficient isolation scoring and elite playmaking force defenses to over-commit and respect his step-back three-point line.
